text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking hours be extended on Alcorn Avenue, between Yonge Street and Oaklands Avenue, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m., 7 days a week. Residents requested the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Alcorn Avenue, to improve parking flexibility and to allow the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, to effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescind the existing permit parking provision in effect on Alcorn Avenue 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. daily on the odd (south) side of Alcorn Avenue, from a point 71 metres west of Yonge Street to Walker Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing permit parking provision in effect on Alcorn Avenue 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. daily on the odd (south) side of Alcorn Avenue, from a point 71 metres west of Yonge Street to Oaklands Avenue. 3. Rescinded the existing permit parking provision in effect on Alcorn Avenue 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. daily on the even (north) side of Alcorn Avenue, Walker Avenue to Oaklands Avenue. 4. Prohibited parking except by permit 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. daily on the odd (south) side of Alcorn Avenue, from a point 71 metres west of Yonge Street to Walker Avenue. 5.
